Log in to a Breedbase server

Source: R/breedbase_brapi.R
breedbase_login.Rd

Logs in through the BrAPI token call and returns a connection used by the other breedbase_*() functions and by save_breedbase(). Only the access token is kept; the password is not stored.

Usage

breedbase_login(
  url,
  username,
  password = NULL,
  site_username = NULL,
  site_password = NULL
)

Arguments

url

Address of the Breedbase site, e.g. "https://cassavabase.org".

username

Your Breedbase username.

password

Optional password; see Details.

site_username, site_password

Only for sites with an extra web password in front of the website (test servers such as cassava-test.sgn.cornell.edu ask for it in a browser pop-up, "Restricted Test Site"): that user name and password. They are used for the non-BrAPI calls (trait composer, analyses); BrAPI does not need them. Usually not needed: when a site asks for a web password, the login first tries your Breedbase user name and password there, and uses them if they work. Leave site_password empty to read it from BREEDBASE_SITE_PASSWORD or to be asked in a pop-up.

Value

A breedbase_connection object.

Details

Never write your password in a script. Leave password empty: it is read from the environment variable BREEDBASE_PASSWORD if set (for example in your .Renviron file), and otherwise you are asked for it in a pop-up.

See also

save_breedbase(), breedbase_programs(), breedbase_folders(), breedbase_locations()

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
con <- breedbase_login("https://cassavabase.org", username = "jdoe")
con
} # }
